feeds.title: The Bourbon Review
feeds.description: The Bourbon Review is your guide to Bourbon, Whiskey, and the Bourbon Lifestyle. We bring you all the insights on the people, places, and events from Bourbon Country.

feeds.title: Bourbon Guy
feeds.description: I'm Arok. I write about, think about, speak about, research & drink: bourbon. This is a bourbon blog with more than tasting notes.

feeds.title: The Chuck Cowdery Blog
feeds.description: Charles K. Cowdery is 'the dean of American whiskey journalism' according to The New York Times. He is a Kentucky Colonel (Patton, 206) and a member of the Kentucky Bourbon Hall of Fame (2009). He is the author of BOURBON, STRANGE: Surprising Stories of American Whiskey.

feeds.title: The Bourbon Road Blog
feeds.description: The Bourbon Road is two Veterans sharing pours and good stories with interesting guests. Each week we sip on bourbon while talking with celebrities, musicians, chefs, authors, industry experts and everyone in between. If bourbon makes it better... or even the other way around, then we want to talk about it.

feeds.title: Fred Minnick
feeds.description: Wall Street Journal-bestselling author Fred Minnick loves his bourbon so much that he's written three books on the subject: Whiskey Women, Bourbon Curious, and Bourbon: The Rise, Fall and Rebirth of An American Whiskey, which Smithsonian Magazine recognized as one of the best food books of 2016 and won Tales of the Cocktail's Spirited Awards' Best Book.

feeds.title: Bourbon Veach
feeds.description: Michael Veach was inducted into the Kentucky Bourbon Hall of Fame in 2006. He's written and contributed to five books and is the foremost authority on bourbon history. In addition to this he is the former Filson Historical Society Bourbon Historian. Michael has provided bourbon history education in many different forms over the years.

feeds.title: Rare Bird 101
feeds.description: Wild turkey bourbon whiskey info, reviews, and musings. Rare Bird 101 is dedicated to the finest American whiskey ever crafted, Wild Turkey. If bourbon is America's Spirit, then Wild Turkey is about as American as it gets. Its roots go back to the 1830s, but the true heart and soul of this brand rests in the hands of the Russell family.

feeds.title: Drinkhacker »
feeds.description: Drinkhacker is the essential site for the discriminating drinker. Founded in 2007 by veteran writer Christopher Null, the website covers spirits, wine, and beer reviews and publishes both new and classic cocktail recipes for hundreds of thousands of monthly readers.

feeds.title: Kentucky Bourbon Trail Blog
feeds.description: The world got its first taste of the profound history and proud tradition of 'America's Official Native Spirit' when the Kentucky Distillers' Association (KDA) established the Kentucky Bourbon Trail in 1999, a road trip-style experience for bourbon lovers to visit the Bluegrass State's signature distilleries.

feeds.title: The Whiskey Reviewer » Bourbon Whiskey
feeds.description: A World of Whiskey, Poured Every Weekday. The Whiskey Reviewer is a web magazine covering the world of whisk(e)y.

feeds.title: Bourbon Central Blog
feeds.description: Bourbon Central helps you to get the rarest and most allocated whiskies & bourbons delivered to your doorstep!

feeds.title: Garrison Brothers Distillery Blog
feeds.description: Come break bourbon with them down in heavenly Hye, TX at Garrison Brothers Distillery, home of the first bourbon distillery outside of Kentucky. Like everything in the Lone Star State, their dreams were big from the start. Follow their informative Garrison Brothers Distillery Blog which shares articles about their whiskey, its making, recipes, feature stories, whiskey history, events and more.

feeds.title: The Bourbon Finder Blog
feeds.description: John is the Maine-based bourbon enthusiast who has been enjoying America's native spirit for well over a decade. The complex flavors and rich history of American whiskey are a driving force in seeking new bottles and great experiences.

feeds.title: The B-Line
feeds.description: Welcome to The B-Line! Northern Kentucky's self-guided Bourbon Trail. Follow for updates on how to do the line.

feeds.title: Bourbon Plus Magazine
feeds.description: We tell stories from the heart of bourbon-the farmers who grow the grain, the distillers who labor over the process, the mixologists who concoct liquid perfection, and the people who raise their glasses to celebrate it all. Our pages bring the bottle to life and pour out story after story of the sacrifice, determination, and passion that go into each charred oak barrel and sweeten the experiences that flow from them.

feeds.title: The Capital City Bourbon Blog
feeds.description: I'm Luke. This is a very simple blog. The reality is that I absolutely love bourbon and whiskey in general. And I love talking about these spirits almost as much as I love drinking them, so a blog seemed like the next logical step.I intend on sharing tasting notes, reviews, recommendations, and various other topics related to bourbon.

feeds.title: Tater-Talk
feeds.description: I'm Wade Woodard, a long time whiskey geek, certified specialist of spirits, whiskey consumer advocate and even sometimes a tater. I worked shortly in the industry as a Bourbon Evangelist, aka salesperson, for a Texas craft distiller, Garrison Brothers.

feeds.title: Bourbon & Oak Blog
feeds.description: The latest in whiskey, gear, news, and reviews. Bourbon & Oak was started in April 2013 with the simple idea of helping others learn about bourbon whiskey. What started with a few reviews and fewer visitors quickly began to grow.

feeds.title: Sipology » Bourbon
feeds.description: I'm Josh, an independent blogger and I write about what I drink. That happens to be Michigan wine and cider, American whiskey, Canadian whisky, brandy, gin, and other things.

feeds.title: Mile High Bourbon and Rye » Bourbon
feeds.description: This section features articles on bourbon. Mile High Bourbon and Rye is aColorado Whiskey Blog started by a couple of whiskey lovers living in this beautiful state.

feeds.title: Rebel Bourbon Blog
feeds.description: Defiantly Smooth Wheated Bourbon

feeds.title: The Whiskey Jar Blog
feeds.description: A Whiskey Blog for the Rest of Us

feeds.title: Whiskey Prof
feeds.description: I'm Bernie Lubbers and I'm known as The Whiskey Professor. Learn about all the Spirit of America, bourbon whiskey, rye whiskey, wheat whiskey; from how it's made, to how to visit Kentucky and the distilleries.

feeds.title: Bourbon Real Talk Blog
feeds.description: Bourbon Real Talk host Randy Sullivan believes in the connective power of whiskey. That, combined with his love of learning, teaching, and loving PEOPLE, brought this blog to life.

feeds.title: The Bourbon Babe
feeds.description: News, reviews, and more about Kentucky's native spirit. Carla Carlton, 'The Bourbon Babe,' conducts educational and entertaining bourbon tastings for both public and private groups - everything from birthday and Derby parties to charitable galas and corporate conferences.

feeds.title: Brian Haara
feeds.description: Brian is a Louisville, Kentucky attorney who found a way to combine his passions for law, bourbon, and history. This website is about bourbon.

feeds.title: WhiskeyBon
feeds.description: We review whiskey, whisky, bourbon and rye from all around the world.

feeds.title: Whisky Critic » Bourbon Reviews
feeds.description: WhiskyCritic.com also features regular bourbon reviews. It's not only about scotch!

feeds.title: Bourbon Truth
feeds.description: Honest, over the top opinion on American Whiskey+some other odds&ends. @bourbontruth on twitter for more stuff. Mastery of the English language & spelling is not my strong suit so if you're looking...

feeds.title: Bourbon & Banter
feeds.description: Bourbon & Banter, founded by Patrick Garrett, is your home for honest reviews, whiskey industry news, and all things related to America's native spirit. As a Chief Bourbon Drinker (CBD), Patrick's goal is to spread the bourbon gospel across the globe.

feeds.title: Bourbon Blog
feeds.description: Bringing a culture, a people, and a passion together in this blog. BourbonBlog.com covers stories that are unique to Bourbon, whiskey and spirits. An entire blog dedicated to Kentucky bourbon whiskey recipes, reviews and so much more!

feeds.title: The Whiskey Wash » Bourbon
feeds.description: The Whiskey Wash is a leading whiskey news and information website focused on telling readers about the whiskey lifestyle.

feeds.title: Whisk(e)y Apostle » Bourbon
feeds.description: Proselytizing the way of the malt. Our goal is still to proselytize the faith of the golden dram. Whether we're answering your questions, helping you find the perfect dram, or just introducing you to the wonderful world of whisky; we want to help you raise a dram and imbibe in the 'water of life.'

feeds.title: Distiller News
feeds.description: Distiller News is a website dedicated to providing news, information, and insights into the world of bourbon, whiskey, craft spirits, and the broader liquor industry. It covers a wide range of topics, including new product releases, industry trends, distiller interviews, and more.

feeds.title: The Whiskey Jug » Bourbon
feeds.description: A whiskey blog for whiskey reviews, whiskey cocktails, recipes, news, and info.

feeds.title: Bourbon Barrel Foods Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with our owner Matt James as he travels the globe with Bourbon Barrel Foods. Learn more about our process as we expand our eat your bourbon mission. Established in 2006 as the U.S.'s only soy sauce microbrewery, Bourbon Barrel Foods has become a cornerstone in both the bourbon and gourmet foods industries.

feeds.title: Bourbon Obsessed Blog
feeds.description: Bourbon Obsessed is the source for distillery information, distillery maps, bourbon reviews and more!
